# HushhTech

> HushhTech is an AI-first investment firm building a portfolio of exceptional, free-cash-flow compounding businesses for the long term — Berkshire Hathaway's discipline run on an AI research and execution stack. This file indexes the firm's public research, fund commentary and investor education.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://hushhtech.com/): What HushhTech is and how it invests.
- [Fund A](https://hushhtech.com/discover-fund-a): The fund's thesis, structure and portfolio design.
- [Philosophy](https://hushhtech.com/about/philosophy): Simplicity, humility and cost-efficiency as investment principles.
- [Leadership](https://hushhtech.com/about/leadership): The people building HushhTech.
- [Community](https://hushhtech.com/community): The full research and commentary library.
- [FAQ](https://hushhtech.com/faq): Common questions on eligibility, fees and process.
- [Risk disclosures](https://hushhtech.com/risk-disclosures): Risk information for prospective and current investors.
